name: new_v2_f2b_f2c_grab_cross_user_candidates_v1
source_fit: Verified GRABMyo Day1 native records; subjects1-4 source, 5-6 validation, 7-8 descriptive final. F0v2 uses source Rest windows only; document CSP and SPD tangent fit all source-user native windows only. Source classifiers use exactly the frozen parent trial aggregation and hyperparameters.
evaluation: All three arms score the identical 112 unseen-user Day1 records. F0v2 probabilities must replay the frozen parent within 1e-8 for every target trial/class. Final users are descriptive and cannot select a candidate.
boundary: Public 8-channel 2048 Hz same-day unseen-user transfer. Distinct from MANUS 200 Hz same-user session and wearing axes. Final users appeared in earlier project studies, so not project-wide fresh holdout. No 250 Hz own-device or live claim.
